item.display: D2330 direct composite restoration, lingual surface, tooth #9

summary: Sarah Okonkwo seen 2026-07-15 per referral from Meridian Teledental (Dr. Webb). Periapical radiograph confirmed irreversible pulpitis with periapical abscess, tooth #9. Root canal therapy completed in a single visit (D3310): the canal space was instrumented and obturated, and the access was conservatively restored in the same visit with a single-surface lingual direct composite (D2330). Patient tolerated the procedure well. A definitive crown is indicated; Sarah has no dental home and is advised to establish one for crown placement. Follow-up periapical radiograph recommended at 6 months. Ibuprofen 400 mg PRN for post-operative discomfort.

note.text: Structured encounter summary returned to the referring teledentistry provider (Dr. Webb, Meridian Teledental) via Da Vinci CDex provider-to-provider push — a single recipient (the originating provider), unlike UC03's two-recipient fan-out. This summary closes the referral loop (see the completed referral Task and ServiceRequest). Transmitted as discrete FHIR, not a PDF. The in-office radiograph itself is not re-transmitted; its conclusion is carried here via the referenced DiagnosticReport.
